searchText: <@!489256758989029405> https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/a3cd8a040a4ffe04a7b455f11a6c049a9b29b1c5/core/vm/testdata/precompiles/modexp.json 'nagydani' is because Daniel Nagy (@nagydani) came up with a few of the vectors . Casey Detrio came up with a few others, hence the cdetrio ones (oh, not for modexp apparently). The vectors were from the very first benchmarking when the precompile was introduced, and all clients implemented them (c++, parity, geth and pyethereum)
